column1: # fanout.sh's jobs for the website's rerun on 0.3.5 (16 November 2026): the
# same-nodes lanes of fanout-jobs-same-nodes.tsv (each lane's engines one
# after another on one set of nodes, ChloeDB first and again last for the
# drift), with the answer cache off (#552) and ChloeDB's beam sent as
# labelled (PRF-3), plus the vector candidates swept on the sharded lanes and,
# for Qdrant and Postgres, on a node of their own (a sweep of all nine
# one-node engines would outrun the lane's timeout).
# Milvus runs alone on a fresh node only: last in the one-node lane it was
# still compacting during its first passes (4 November's README).
